title: Cat motif
subtitle: A flat applique cat face with pointed ears and whisker chains, 8 cm
excerpt: The cat motif is a flat applique face: a round dc centre for the head, two triangular ear extensions worked from the top edge, simple embroidered eyes and nose, and chain-length whiskers anchored at the sides. At 8 cm in DK cotton it scales well to cushion appliques, blanket squares, and bag decoration.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from flat applique animal motif construction. Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 9 (1894), worked animal motifs chapter (Internet Archive).
heroPrompt: A crochet cat face applique in grey DK cotton with cream ears, chain whiskers, and embroidered eyes, photographed flat on natural linen in soft daylight. 8 cm, clearly recognisable as a sitting cat face.

glossaryTerms.definition: A separately worked piece sewn onto the surface of a base fabric. This cat motif is worked as a flat applique and sewn onto the finished background.

content.text: The cat motif uses a round dc disc for the head worked outward from a
applique

magic ring, then two pointed ear extensions worked in place from the top edge. Whiskers are chain lengths anchored at the face border with a slip stitch and trimmed to 4 cm. Embroidered features are the finishing step: two French knot eyes, a small inverted-V nose, and a curved mouth in a contrasting thread.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 8 g of DK cotton in the main face colour, plus a small amount of contrast for inner ears (optional). A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Embroidery thread for features. Scissors.

content.text: Gauge
Each finished cat motif measures 8 cm tall and 7 cm wide in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
Stitches used
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st), magic ring (MR) — UK and US shared.
double crochet (dc) — UK; US "single crochet".
half treble (htr) — UK; US "half double crochet".
Pattern
Head

Form a magic ring. Ch 1 (does not count as stitch). Rnd 1: 6dc into ring. Sl st to join. (6 dc.) Rnd 2: 2dc in each dc around. Sl st to join. (12 dc.) Rnd 3: *Dc. 2dc in next dc.* Repeat 6 times. Sl st to join. (18 dc.) Rnd 4: *Dc. Dc. 2dc in next dc.* Repeat 6 times. Sl st to join. (24 dc.) Do not fasten off.
Ears — 2 times

The ears are worked from the top edge of the head. Identify the top centre dc, count 3 dc to the left for the left ear base. Sl st into the 3rd dc from centre. Ch 1. Dc. Htr. Tr (ear tip). Htr. Dc. Sl st back into the starting dc to close the ear. Fasten off. Rejoin yarn at 3 dc to the right of centre for the right ear; repeat. Weave in ends.
Whiskers

Thread a length of yarn through a tapestry needle. Take the needle through the face border dc at the left cheek, leave 4 cm tails on each side. Repeat twice to make 3 whiskers on each side. Trim to length.

definition.title: Cat motif
definition.caption: Round head: 4 increase rounds from 6dc magic ring to 24dc. Ear: ch-1 triangle in dc/htr/tr/htr/dc from the head border.

content.text: Finishing
Embroider two French knot eyes and an inverted-V nose in contrasting thread. Add a small curved mouth below the nose. Sew the motif onto the base fabric with a tapestry needle and matching thread.
Care
Handwash with the base fabric. The chain whiskers may need light straightening when damp.
What to try next
The bird motif (crochet-animal-bird) uses a similar round disc head with a beak extension. The rabbit motif (crochet-animal-rabbit) adds long ear panels using the same ear construction as the cat.
